messages:
Elena: Quick heads-up — AtlasHealth is ready for SI handoff. Customer insists on private deployment (VPC + on-prem HSM). They want a short architecture review and checklist before the SI team starts implementation. Proposed Wed 10am PT. @Anika can you own the arch slot? @James can you sanity-check HSM integration?

Anika: I can take Wed 10am. Will prepare a 20m run-through + a one-pager with network/firewall reqs. Need to know if we must support cross-region fallback for failover.

James: Noted. HSM vendor is SafeKey — I need the cert exchange flow and whether customer will provide PKCS#11 endpoint or HSM proxy. If they're using on-prem HSM, expect additional firewall ports.

Elena: Customer will provide HSM proxy endpoint. They've asked Redwood to validate keywrap and CSR flow. Also want KMS audit logging enabled.

sre-bot: Reminder: please include egress & peering checklist. Template: 
```
- outbound ports: 443 (control), 10250 (k8s), 9000 (metrics)
- allowed CIDR: partner datacenter /24
- peering: accept route propagation
```

Priya (SI): Thanks — SI team will need the network diagram + the exact kube node size recommendation. Also any preferred quantization/instance types from runtime team would help.

Liam: Runtime note: for AtlasHealth workload (seq len ~1k, low concurrency), recommend g5.12x for dedicated capacity or a q8_0 quantized instance on A100 for cost-sensitive private. We'll document perf+latency tradeoffs in the slide.

Anika: I'll add the runtime recommendations to the one-pager. For cert exchange: @James, can you confirm the CSR steps so I can include them in the playbook?

James: CSR steps (short):
1) Generate key on HSM via PKCS#11
2) Produce CSR -> submit to Redwood CA (we support SCEP or manual)
3) CA issues cert -> import via HSM proxy API
Will put a short checklist in Confluence after call.

Elena: Slight escalation — customer hit a blocker on initial test: HSM proxy is behind a NAT that rewrites source IPs and breaks mTLS handshake with our control plane. They asked if we can accept NATed IPs or provide a relay.

Liam: Relay possible but needs SRE signoff. Could also suggest enabling TLS termination at a trusted edge in their VPC.

Anika: Let's discuss relay vs edge on Wed. Can SRE attend? @James, can you bring network logs?

James: I'll grab the packet captures and mTLS logs.

Priya (SI): SI team requests our go/no-go checklist for announcing the joint engagement (customer PR). We should avoid public announcement until HSM integration validated.

Elena: Agreed — no public PR until integration validated and runbook created. For announcement planning: once arch review passes, we'll schedule a joint customer brief and draft a co-branded blog.

sre-bot: Action items created: 
- Arch review Wed 10am PT: owner Anika
- Packet captures + mTLS logs: owner James
- Runtime hardware recs: owner Liam
- SI checklist + runbook draft: owner Priya
- No announcement until validation: owner Elena

Anika: I'll upload the one-pager and invite link 24h before. Agenda: 1) Network/HSM flow 2) Runtime & instance recs 3) Rollout plan + canary 4) Announcement gating checklist.

Elena: Perfect. If anything blocks earlier, ping me in this thread. :thumbsup:

Priya (SI): Thanks — we'll prep our deployment checklist and share vendor contact for SafeKey. See you Wed. :wave:
